=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1322-1330 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: When the job token hits a transient 5xx or network error (reason=error), `_gh_read_run()` always falls back to the PAT, and only the PAT's stderr reaches `gh_retry`. While the PAT is exhausted, the PAT returns "API rate limit exceeded", so `gh_retry` treats the attempt as a PAT rate limit. It then sends the Telegram alert, trips the shared core breaker and calls `_gh_rate_limit_wait`, which sleeps for up to 600 s per wait and up to 4 waits.
  WHY: Before this PR, the same 502 was retried on the job token with a 1/2/4/8 s backoff. Now the per-tick polls stall for up to 40 minutes during every PAT-exhausted window and raise false rate-limit alerts: `promote_main_cycle.sh:1830/1881`, `workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:252/290` and `gh_review_pr_state` at `gh_helpers.sh:1032/1048`. The tests miss this because `SITES_FAKE_GH` always lets the PAT succeed.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1317-1330 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new reason=error path in `_gh_read_run` falls back to the PAT without latching the job token off. When both tokens fail transiently, every `gh_retry` attempt repeats both requests: up to 5 job-token plus 5 PAT requests per call (`gh_retry` lines 2782-2784; `GH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS=5`).
  WHY: During an outage, the polling paths spend twice the API calls and more PAT budget, against the PAT-conservation goal of #9888. Severity disagreement: gemini and luna rated it MAJOR, while minimax and glm rated it NIT because the no-latch behaviour is a documented trade-off.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1356-1378 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `_pr_checks_wait_read` header comment still says "a failing routed path costs one call and the fallback alone owns the retry schedule". After this PR, a reason=error failure costs two calls: the job token, then one unretried PAT call at `gh_helpers.sh:1330`. Only after that does the `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq` schedule at line 1377 run.
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime. During sustained 5xx windows each poll spends one extra PAT call, and the stale comment misstates the cost for whoever next tunes the wait budget.
- changelog.d/9888-gh-read-token-polling.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unfolded fragment lists `GH_READ_FALLBACK reason=<401|403|404|rate_limit>` without `|error`. README.md, `agents.d/9888-gh-read-token-polling.md` and the new `changelog.d/9888-gh-read-fallback-hardening.md` all add `error` to the contractual set. The `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` header comment at lines 1077-1079 also omits it (sonnet).
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime. The assembled release notes will contradict each other about a stable log prefix, and a log consumer keyed on the documented set will not expect reason=error.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Switch the per-tick read calls in the listed polling loops to gh_read.
  expected_change_site: scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh, scripts/dispatch_and_watch_workflow_run.sh, scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh, scripts/validate_process.sh, scripts/validate_driver.sh, scripts/stable_orchestrate_cancel_dispatched_run.sh, scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The per-tick read calls in these scripts have not been updated to use gh_read. The required GH_READ_TOKEN export and the permission scope update have not been implemented for the jobs that run these loops.
- requirement: "tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py and tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py pass."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py acceptance check and .github/workflows/*.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description marks tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py as unmet and lists it as an inherited failure. No workflow file is modified and no hunk addresses the size guard or its threshold. tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py is marked met.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:_gh_read_run(), lines 1322-1330; gh_retry() lines 2836-2842; _sleep_until_reset() lines 1783-1792 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A transient 5xx or network failure on the job token always sends the read to the PAT, and only the PAT's stderr reaches `gh_retry`. While the PAT is at 0, `gh_retry` sees "API rate limit exceeded", sends the Telegram alert, trips the core breaker and sleeps up to 600 s per wait, up to 4 waits.
  WHY: The per-tick polls (`promote_main_cycle.sh:1830/1881`, `workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:252/290`, `gh_helpers.sh:1032/1048`) stall for up to 40 minutes on a job-token blip that would otherwise have recovered, and raise false alerts. Suggested fix: skip the PAT fallback while `gh_rate_limit_breaker_active core` is true, or, when the PAT also fails, return the job-token stderr and rc.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_pr_checks_wait_read() header comment, lines 1356-1358 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The comment "a failing routed path costs one call…" understates the cost. A 5xx now makes a job-token call plus an unretried PAT call (`gh_helpers.sh:1330`) before the `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq` schedule at line 1377.
  WHY: Nothing fails. Each poll spends one extra PAT call during 5xx windows, and the comment misleads future work on this budget.
- changelog.d/9888-gh-read-token-polling.md:line 2, "GH_READ_FALLBACK reason=<401|403|404|rate_limit>" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: This fragment and the `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` header comment at lines 1077-1079 keep the four-value set, while README.md, the agents.d fragment and the new hardening fragment add `error`.
  WHY: The release notes will contradict each other about a stable log prefix. Fix: add "|error" in both places.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Rejected the pass-1 gaps because the gh_read migration already exists on the base branch and the file-size test failure is inherited.
- HARDENING scripts/gh_helpers.sh:_gh_read_run(), lines 1300-1324: any non-zero rc counts as failure. Allowlisted `pr checks` (line 1098) exits 1 or 8 with valid output, so a future `gh_read pr checks` poll would discard the job token's valid answer. Suggested fix: remove it from the allowlist, or pass the job-token result through for `pr checks`.
- HARDENING scripts/gh_helpers.sh:_gh_read_run(), line 1322: the reason=error fallback runs even while the breaker records the PAT core bucket as exhausted. Suggested fix: check `gh_rate_limit_breaker_active core` and return the job-token stderr and rc. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
